summary: A Yes vote enacts a $75-per-parcel tax for four years, raising about $177,600 annually to fund the district's garden enrichment program and student mental health and academic intervention services, with an exemption available to those 65 and older.

tax.text: Measure M would impose a $75 annual parcel tax for four years to fund garden enrichment, mental health, and academic intervention services.
tax.quote: To maintain and enhance quality education programs by funding Harmony Union School District’s Garden Enrichment Program at Harmony and Salmon Creek School, a comprehensive farm-to-table interactive education program, as well as student mental health and academic intervention services, shall Harmony Union School District’s education parcel tax measure be adopted, at the rate of $75 per year (raising approximately $177,600 annually), for four years, with an exemption for those 65 years and older and all funds spent on local students?

schools.text: Measure M would direct locally raised tax revenue to educational and student-support programs in Harmony Union School District schools.
schools.quote: Measure M funds will be used to support several key programs constrained by lack of sufficient funding, including the Garden Enrichment Program, Mental Health Services and Academic Intervention Services.

tax.text: A No vote rejects Measure M’s proposed $75 annual parcel tax for four years.
tax.quote: Measure M is fixed at $75 per parcel per year.
